author: Collin Times
title: Rep. Keith Self highlights legislative priorities on education, transparency, and Trump-era policies
text:
Keith Self, U.S. Representative for Texas from District 3 | Official U.S. House Headshot
Rep. Keith Self, a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Texas's 3rd congressional district, shared a series of posts on July 23, 2025, addressing education policy, government transparency, and legislative efforts to codify former President Trump's policies.
In a post at 13:46 UTC, Rep. Self commented on the issue of education governance and fiscal responsibility: "Saving taxpayer dollars while returning education back to the states where it belongs? That’s a win-win. "
Later that day at 14:29 UTC, he addressed concerns about criminal justice and transparency: " Rep. Keith Self: 'We want to expose the criminals, we want to protect the victims...this seems to be the only way we're going to get to do it.' Americans across the nation are calling for transparency. Let’s deliver it."
At 16:21 UTC, Rep. Self announced new legislative initiatives tied to former President Donald Trump’s administration: "President Trump won’t be the president forever. That’s why we need to get to work NOW to ensure his executive orders and DOGE savings can’t be reversed. Today, I introduced a legislative package codifying four of President Trump’s America First policies. "
Rep. Keith Self has previously advocated for decentralizing federal control over education and increasing state authority in related policy decisions. Calls for greater transparency in government have been a recurring theme among Republican lawmakers in recent years.
